skill_name: Summarize the following article about a new medical treatment.
workflow: A recent study published in Nature has shown that the new drug ABC-123 is effective in treating six different forms of cancer. It works by blocking a pathway which the tumor cells need to divide and spread. This makes the tumor cells sensitive to other cancer treatments which can result in shrinking or complete removal of the tumor. This medical breakthrough has been met with enthusiasm from medical professionals and cancer patients alike.
